preText: Toss: Nellai Royal Kings won the toss and are fielding Brilliant news of the day - It's going to be a 12-over game and toss at 5.20 PM Shantanu Raj: "Hari Nishanth is the batter every team needs,he is a perfect batter with patience,awareness of the game and most importantly he knows which ball should be punished" Fun fact: Nellai Royal Kings' Arya Yohan Menon is the son of director Gautham Vasudev Menon. Arya has played age-group cricket for TN and originally started the TNPL as a net bowler, but impressed the team management so much that he broke into the main squad Before we could think of reduction in overs it has started to drizzle Good News!: Rain has stopped! Our hunter of all T20 leagues around the world, Deiva, had spoken to Ganeshan Periyaswamy where he said "Kanavu maari irukku" [It feels like a dream] Sarvesh: "2019 Final was another rabbit out of the hat from CSG. Defending just under 130 and to win it on the final over was something special." Yes Sarvesh, Ganeshan Periyaswamy's bowling in the final over of the final match was something else. He had an amazing season as well Meanwhile, Australia have taken the lead in their Test v Sri Lanka Sarvesh: "Last year final was epic. Game was done and dusted in 15 th over of the chase but Sarvana Kumar had other ideas until Sai Kishore bowled one of the best final over of the match" Yes, 13 runs were required off the final over and Sai Kishore conceded only 4. We all know what happened to R Sai Kishore after that. He took 2 wickets in the final of this edition of IPL Narayan Jagadeesan is a bonafide legend of TNPL, having got the Player of the Series award twice. He was involved in an unsavory incident a few days back but was quick to realise his fault and tendered his apologies My co-commentator for the day, Chandan, picks this game as his favourite. As you can see, the 2017 edition of TNPL is something we all loved. This edition of TNPL is also shaping up to be a classic Vairavan also picks a game from 2017 edition. His favourite match is this one. One of my favourite matches is the final of 2017 edition. Till the rain stops, let's recollect the best TNPL matches. Which is that match that you like the most over the years? Saad Kutesra : "Toss delay?" Yes, because it's raining sarvesh: "TNPL has hitters like Vivek Raj, Anthony Dhas " and bowlers who bowl mean yorkers! Vairavan has an update for us "It's raining". Well, we will have to wait and watch for now Our in-house TNPL expert, K Vairavan, says that a lot of players have gone on to represent IPL teams after their superb performances in TNPL, which is true Diamond: "Yes, Sachin. It is." Sachin Iyengar: "This is the best franchise cricket in India after IPL" Nellai Royal Kings are at the top of the points table Hello all and welcome to the coverage of the 7th match of this edition of TNPL. Nellai Royal Kings play Dindigul Dragons today in the first match of what is a terrific Thursday - a double -header game
